# Data Gap Log

Use this log only for missing market evidence that needs user confirmation, local files, paywalled sources, inaccessible pages, product-model conflicts, review limits, or unclear ASIN/SKU mapping. Under frozen quantity-policy v3+, a market-gap quantity exception also requires completed R1/R2/R3 tasks and count audits, a JSON audit of per-round queries/source IDs/failure reasons/raw captures, zero remaining high-priority discoveries, complete impact/owner/resolution metadata, and named/date-stamped human approval. Mathematical-model input gaps must be filled with calibrated reproducible simulation and tracked in `12_Model_Assumptions.csv` plus `14_Simulated_Modeling_Data.csv`, not here.
